<template>
  <v-container>
    <v-form>
      <v-label class="custom-label-color" text="Nome"></v-label>
      <v-text-field 
        v-model.trim="user.nome.$model" 
        variant="outlined" 
        name="nome" 
        placeholder="Seu nome"
        type="nome">
      </v-text-field>

      <v-label class="custom-label-color" text="E-mail"></v-label>
      <v-text-field 
        v-model.trim="user.email.$model" 
        variant="outlined" 
        name="email" 
        placeholder="Seu e-mail"
        type="email">
      </v-text-field>

      <v-label class="custom-label-color mt-3" text="Senha"></v-label>
      <v-text-field 
        v-model.trim="user.senha.$model" 
        variant="outlined" 
        name="senha" 
        placeholder="Sua senha"
        type="senha">
      </v-text-field>

      <v-label class="custom-label-color mt-3" text="Confirmação Senha"></v-label>
      <v-text-field 
        v-model.trim="user.senha.$model" 
        variant="outlined" 
        name="senha" 
        placeholder="Sua senha"
        type="senha">
      </v-text-field>
    </v-form>
  </v-container>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: 'CadastroView',
  data() {
    return {
      user: {
        nome: '',
        email: '',
        senha: '',
        confirmacaoSenha: ''
      }
    }
  },
  methods: {

  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.titulo-login {
  white-space: wrap;
}

span {
  color: #F30168;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
  cursor: default;
}

.custom-subtitle {
  color: black !important;
  font-weight: 600;
}
</style>
